items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: And they called him Clarinet Brown. He was teaching stock, you know, to the kids.

ctx.x: So I took some house paint--and this was a hell of a bass, man, really this was one of the--hell of a--bass had a hell of a sound. Had to be old, you know. I'm a kid. I'm still a teenager, you know. And I took some house paint and painted the damn bass. And that was the end of that bass. That fucked the bass all up, man. The bass didn't have no sound. But, but anyway, several of the little jive bands around town--there was a band called--a band leader round there, a guy who had a bunch of young guys. And they…
